children: Grayscale CoinDesk Crypto 5 ETF entered into a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital on Sep 29 2026, making the Fund a party to Anchorage Digital’s custodian agreement. Anchorage Digital will safeguard a portion of the Fund’s components, while Coinbase remains the primary custodian. The Manager will allocate assets between custodians at its discretion and notes the move supports ongoing risk management as the fund grows. Anchorage maintains U.S.-based key storage and insurance coverage; related custodian fees are Manager-paid.
: Custody services agreement (Sixth Amendment to Master Custody Service Agreement)
